title: AI Governance Indicator Register
focal_question: How will the global AI governance landscape evolve, and what are the implications for organizations developing or deploying AI systems?
note: This is the toolkit's worked example. Statuses and thresholds reflect a Q4 2024 starting point and have not been refreshed. See framework/probability_updates.md for the review cadence.

indicators.source: Lab blogs, arXiv, press releases, product launches
indicators.threshold: Release whose capability gains clearly exceed the prior 12-month trend (not a routine iteration)
Two or more senior safety researchers leave a frontier lab within a quarter citing safety concerns

indicators.source: Government announcements, UN, OECD, bilateral summits
indicators.threshold: Binding multilateral AI agreement announced (not a voluntary declaration)
Comprehensive federal AI bill passes committee or a floor vote
First major fine or compliance order issued under the EU AI Act

indicators.source: Press, incident databases, regulatory filings, academic papers
indicators.threshold: Incident causing significant harm or a credible near-miss, with a regulatory or lab response
Mandatory compute reporting or licensing formally proposed by a major jurisdiction
Displacement rate in AI-exposed sectors exceeds historical automation trends

indicators.source: Commerce Dept, press, trade policy analysis
indicators.threshold: Major new export restrictions or retaliatory measures announced

indicators.source: Grant announcements, budget documents, lab commitments
indicators.threshold: >50% year-over-year increase in government or philanthropic AI safety funding
